nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 18 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine four independent previous-close/current-day early observations updated at 21:43 WAT on 18 Nov and 03:00, 04:07 and 06:06 WAT on 19 Nov, rechecked at 08:04 WAT. The published extrema preserve cross-source and location dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. These are early observations, not live opening or executable quotes. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.

Ghana.note: Bank of Ghana interbank mid-rates, 18 Nov (latest dated table); buy/sell and mid rows read directly.

Kenya.note: CBK commercial-banks' average closing rates, 18 Nov (latest dated table); not a standalone buy or sell quote.

South Africa.note: SARB weighted-average bank rates, 18 Nov; directly verified from the SARB HomePageRates endpoint.

Egypt.note: CBE official buy/sell mid-rates, 18 Nov; buy/sell rows independently verified and midpoints recomputed.
